description: Format a number as an Arabic currency amount with the correct symbol, grouping, and decimal precision (e.g. 1234.5 SAR -> "1,234.50 ر.س"). Handles the 2025-2026 Unicode currency-symbol transition (Saudi Riyal U+20C1, etc.).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. 'SAR', 'AED', 'KWD'. Defaults to SAR-area default.

name: format_currency
